publisher_heading_path: Stand-in or X-Code Approval after Issuer Decline

finding: E22 question gives no reason code or subtype. Gold passages are in a specialized publisher section; their presence in gold does not establish general applicability. Earlier description of these as general guidance was incorrect.
implications: Do not exempt these passages from scope flags merely because they are gold.
Existing question/gold completeness scores describe coverage of frozen expected text, not proof that the expected answer applies.
Applicability remains unestablished, not proven inapplicable; do not label policy text false.
Baseline gold and outputs remain unchanged; record defect as an evaluation limitation.
Any revised benchmark must explicitly supply the source subsection scope or request clarification, be separately versioned and reviewed.
decision: Retain diagnostic flags and frozen baseline. Prepare a separately versioned applicability contract before filtering or generating again.
